steps.title: Get the generated CI green on main
steps.why: The repo had no CI, so nothing ran the checks on a push or pull request. alpha generates .github/workflows/ci.yml; it must pass on GitHub.

acceptance.run: test -f .github/workflows/ci.yml && gh run list --workflow ci.yml --branch main --limit 1 --json conclusion --jq ".[0].conclusion" | grep -qx success

steps.title: Name the real file in a decode error
steps.why: cli._project reports every ValueError as a principles.toml problem, so a non-UTF-8 README makes apply blame a file that does not exist (src/alpha/cli.py:517, src/alpha/apply.py:84).

steps.title: Name only alpha commands that exist in messages
steps.why: recipe try tells the user to run alpha adopt apply, which is not a command (src/alpha/recipe_cli.py:276).

steps.title: Block commands the guard cannot parse
steps.why: split_segments returns None on a shlex error and check_command then checks nothing, so --no-verify after an ANSI-C quoted word passes (project-files/hooks/guard_bash.py:89, 252).

steps.title: Block a merge when gh cannot report the PR head
steps.why: pr_head returns None when gh fails or times out and check_merge then skips the head comparison R9.2 requires (project-files/hooks/guard_bash.py:492-527).

steps.title: Test R9.2 through the command guard
steps.why: No test asserts that gh pr merge is blocked while the PR head on GitHub differs from local HEAD; the only R9.2 test calls review.gate directly.

steps.title: Run the end-to-end suite in CI
steps.why: addopts deselects slow tests and nothing else runs them, so the tests behind R1.1, R1.3, R3.3 and R12.2 run only by hand (pyproject.toml:12).

steps.title: Pin Python and uv in mise.toml
steps.why: mise install installs only typos, rumdl and agnix, and no Python is pinned, so the documented setup fails without uv and tests run on whatever Python uv picks (mise.toml:6-9).

steps.title: Run the Python 3.11 test without skipping
steps.why: The only test of the 3.11 minimum skips when python3.11 is not on PATH, so newer syntax passes every check (tests/end-to-end/test_cli.py:36-39).

acceptance.run: out=$(uv run --python 3.11 pytest -q -rs tests/end-to-end/test_cli.py) && ! printf %s "$out" | grep -q SKIPPED

steps.title: Record each tool-dependent skip as an exception
steps.why: Six tests skip when a tool is missing, with no row in an Exceptions table, so a runner without them gets a green run that proves less.

acceptance.run: for f in test_pyguard.py test_session_start.py test_render_tooling.py test_defaults.py test_bootstrap_slow.py test_cli.py; do grep -q "$f" CONTRIBUTING.md || exit 1; done

steps.title: Narrow Optionals instead of ignoring pyright
steps.why: Six type: ignore[union-attr] and one pyright: ignore silence strict pyright in tests with no recorded reason (tests/unit/test_core_areas.py:543-578, tests/integration/test_render_tooling.py:80).

acceptance.run: ! grep -rnE "type: ignore|pyright: ignore" tests && uv run pyright

steps.title: Share one timed git runner in src
steps.why: gitops, adopt, rendered, purge and status each wrap git with their own timeout and error wording, and fixes such as core.quotepath reach only one.

acceptance.run: test $(grep -rnE "^def (_git|run_git|git_output)[(]" src/alpha | wc -l) -le 1 && uv run pytest -q

steps.title: Read project.json only through answers.py
steps.why: adopt, status, recipe_cli, apply and generate each re-parse project.json and dig through raw dicts, though the spec says it is parsed once at the boundary into frozen dataclasses.

acceptance.run: test $(grep -rnE "PROJECT_JSON[)][.]read_text|json[.]loads[(]path[.]read_text" src/alpha | grep -v answers.py | wc -l) -le 1 && uv run pytest -q

steps.title: Log a reason for each dev dependency
steps.why: deptry, pyright, pytest, pytest-xdist, pyyaml, ruff and types-pyyaml have no recorded reason; the dependency log starts empty.

acceptance.run: for d in deptry pyright pytest pytest-xdist pyyaml ruff types-pyyaml; do grep -q "$d" docs/alpha/dependencies.md || exit 1; done

steps.title: Say in the README that alpha needs Python 3.11
steps.why: bin/alpha refuses to run below Python 3.11, but the README Needs section lists only uv, pnpm, rustup and mise.

identity.name: alpha
identity.value_proposition: alpha puts a development process into a project for Claude Code to work under: principles, docs, Claude Code and git hooks, CI, and a test setup per component that passes from the first commit. Each principle is checked by a hook or by a reviewer agent before a change reaches main.

releases.process: Bump the version in pyproject.toml, src/alpha/__init__.py and .claude-plugin/plugin.json (then uv lock) in a "chore: Release X.Y.Z" pull request; after it merges, tag vX.Y.Z on main and publish a GitHub release with the notes. Users get it with claude plugin marketplace update alpha.
